verdict.rationale: Honeybadger can be automated without the UI. It has an official CLI with a `honeybadger deploy` command and REST APIs for reporting deployments, uploading source maps, reporting exceptions and listing faults. Those are the typical steps run from a deploy or CI pipeline, and a community user confirms deploy-tracking automation through the Capistrano integration. Missing for 10: explicit CI documentation (e.g. a GitHub Action or pipeline examples), evidence that the CLI works outside the Ruby gem context, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of headless CI use.
